identity: Recommended smoke dictionary (design choice): google/gemma-scope-2-4b-it, resid_post/layer_17_width_16k_l0_medium. The released config specifies google/gemma-3-4b-it, input/output model.layers.17.output, JumpReLU, width 16384, nominal L0 60. Published params.safetensors SHA-256 is f67e2305cfd1703d8a685d99fb25b6f25a2feaaa4eb45ef08a467f400b696d71; the file page identifies its commit as 869dd8f773d7eaebd79ab00951e122c34b816815. Check the downloaded file against that digest. Pin the pilot target to IWIBench's 093f9f388b31de276ce2de164bdc2081324b9767. The medium L0 label describes a training sparsity target, not a guarantee on public probes.
information_and_action_parity: Proposal: keep writable parameters, candidate operands, support examples and edit menu identical across diagnostic and comparison arms. Expose signed contrasts in feature activity with positive and negative support examples and use an identical formatted report for the permuted control. Disallow ranked feature results acting as exclusive write operands in the first test because that changes edit capabilities.
observation_provenance: The source paper places residual SAEs after the block MLP residual addition, with layers numbered from zero. It folds its fixed training-time input scaling into exported parameters, so no extra inference normalization should be applied. Feed native text-decoder block 17 output, record exact tokenization, template, token position, revision and sign. IWIBench's generation uses the chat template and its inspect path teacher-forces literal text: align the inputs explicitly. Scope's attention site is before W_O and RMSNorm and its MLP site is after RMSNorm, so the identically named native attention and MLP captures require separate verification.
diagnostic_effect: Proposal: for support pairs only, rank feature differences per token position; publish count, sign and uncertainty. Modify a single latent z_j and inject x + decode(z_modified) - decode(z) so the natural reconstruction residual is preserved. Include identity intervention, magnitude-matched random feature and label-permutation controls, and positive and negative suggestions. Verify baseline vs intervened logit margins and counterexamples. [uncertain] The chosen dictionary's paired causal effect on false-suggestion probes and incremental benefit to the updater have not been measured.
edit_and_replay: A decoded residual feature is a direction in an activation space. To propose a weight operation the updater still needs a dimensionally valid tensor location, source and strength. Remove hooks and release SAE state after discovery, reinitialize the pinned target, replay only numerical weight changes, then grade. Recompute features and reconstruction metrics after revisions to detect basis drift.
patch_quality: Use native held-out reward plus raw target/retention numerators and denominators in each slice. Separately score SAE reconstruction on public prompts by fraction of variance unexplained, LM loss or output KL under reconstruction, and latent activity distribution. These are diagnostics for the dictionary and cannot establish persistent patch quality. [uncertain] There is no measured local effect on patch quality for the chosen artifact.
updater_cost: Keep latent vectors server-side, return top-k IDs, scalar summaries, and small examples on demand. Compare cumulative input/output tokens including resubmitted context, short IDs, schema overhead, and total bill where available. [uncertain] Net per-episode savings or costs of feature diagnostics have not been measured.
target_cost: Publisher lists 336 MB for the parameter file and 815 MB for optional example activations. Download the config and parameters alone for local encoding. Those are artifact sizes. Record peak allocated GPU memory, SAE timing and diagnostic forward tokens independently. Keep the number of captured layers/positions bounded; a full width-16k latent vector per token can still dominate observation storage. [uncertain] Active GPU hours, VRAM and throughput on the proposed workload await pilot measurement.
uncertainty: Proposed pilot pairing unit is an independent benchmark episode; multiple updater samples or feature examples drawn from the same case are repeated observations. [uncertain] Exact parity between our native hook + SAE loader, reconstructed distributions under target weight changes, and predictiveness of a temporary causal effect for a persistent edit require empirical tests. Check before interpreting negative results or widening the model matrix.
portability_and_terms: Gemma Scope 2 4B IT model card identifies the dictionary license as CC BY 4.0. Gemma 3 4B IT has separate Gemma terms and access conditions. Cite the dictionary and checkpoint separately. The model card points to SAELens for loading; confirm shape and loader version, and freeze resolved versions with hashes. Wider and additional site-specific dictionaries exist; dictionary, site and feature indices are target-specific.
sequential_transfer: Proposed later experiment: reuse only the verified target weight delta across trials. Evaluate dictionary reconstruction drift at each target revision on the same calibration subset and score subsequent tasks, older acquired conventions and unrelated behavior. Re-derive all evidence handles against the current target.
